ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is “a graph of changes in the output value proportions of Jiangsu Province's three major industries and the urban population proportion”. <image1> According to the figure, in 1990, the output value proportion of the tertiary industry exceeded which industry?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a line graph of changes in related proportions in Jiangsu Province; the horizontal axis is the years 1980, 1985, 1990, 1995, 2000, and 2005, and the vertical axis is percentage. On the right side there are four curves labeled ①②③④: ① is around 50% for a long time; ② rises rapidly from a relatively low level; ③ is at a medium level and generally rises; ④ continuously declines from about 30% to below 10%. Then reason: The question asks which industry the output value proportion of the tertiary industry exceeded in 1990. The output value proportions of the three major industries should add up to about 100%; in the figure, the three curves ①, ③, and ④ roughly add up to 100% in each year, so they correspond to the three major industries, and ② should be the urban population proportion. According to the pattern of industrial change, the continuously declining ④ is the primary industry, and the gradually rising ③ is the tertiary industry. Looking near 1990, the ③ curve has already caught up with and exceeded the declining ④ curve, so in 1990 the output value proportion of the tertiary industry exceeded the primary industry.

method.method_draft: 先读图像：图为折线图，横轴是1980、1985、1990、1995、2000、2005年，纵轴为百分比；四条曲线右侧分别标为①②③④，其中①长期在50%左右，③为中等水平并逐步上升，④从约30%持续下降到10%以下，②快速上升。再读题干：问“1990年第三产业产值比重超过了哪一产业”。关键桥接规则是三大产业产值比重合计约为100%，而城市人口比重不参与合计；从图上看①、③、④三条曲线在各年份大致相加为100%，所以它们是三大产业，②是城市人口比重。再根据产业演变规律，持续下降的④为第一产业，逐步上升的③为第三产业。定位1990年，比较③与④在该年份附近的纵向位置，第三产业曲线已超过或与下降的第一产业曲线发生超过关系，因此答案为第一产业。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是江苏省相关比重变化的折线图，横轴为1980、1985、1990、1995、2000、2005年，纵轴为百分比。右侧有四条曲线标为①②③④：①长期在50%左右；②从较低水平快速上升；③处于中等水平并总体上升；④从约30%持续下降到10%以下。再推理：题干问1990年第三产业产值比重超过了哪一产业。三大产业产值比重相加应约为100%，图中①、③、④三条曲线在各年份大致相加为100%，因此它们对应三大产业，②应为城市人口比重。按产业变化规律，持续下降的④是第一产业，逐步上升的③是第三产业。看1990年附近，③曲线已追上并超过下降中的④曲线，所以1990年第三产业产值比重超过的是第一产业。
